description: Election Commission - A member of the Delft Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member
categorisation: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local authority (Delft Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the composition of elected bodies, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
